source: ABCD agent guidelines (Chen et al. 2021, arXiv 2104.00783), data/guidelines.json

rules.statement: If the order has already shipped (In Transit, Out for Delivery, or Delivered), only Silver and Gold members may receive the new item as an expedited, no-fee separate shipment; other membership levels are not eligible for this accommodation.
If the order has not yet shipped (status Order Received), the new item is permitted to be added directly to the existing order.
Before adding an item to an order, the agent must verify identity using full name, account ID, order ID, and phone number via Verify Identity.
